content: Should this channel be called dev or lean-dev so as to avoid people posting here merely because their project is about Lean?

Yea, perhaps…whilst to some( or hopefully most ) it may make obvious sense that if this entire zulip is already about Lean 4, then perhaps the channel “lean4” should not be interpreted as “generic topics including lean 4”. As well as the description of the channel, but alas…
Note there is already #lean4 dev
